title: AdditionalNumber - Data API
description: Represents an optional additional number for a call center. This additional number is visible in the call center's phone directory.

CallCenterId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CallCenterId.description: System field that contains the ID of the user who created the call center associated with this additional number. If value is null, this additional number is displayed in every call center's phone directory.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: Description of the additional number, such as Conference Room B.Limit: 255 characters.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the additional number.Limit: 80 characters.

Phone.properties: Create, Filter, Nillable, Group, Sort, Update
Phone.description: The phone number that corresponds to this additional number.

special_access_rules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.
usage: Create an additional number for a call center directory. Use this object if the number is not easily categorized as a User, Contact, Lead, Account, or the other object. Examples include phone queues or conference rooms.
wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="AdditionalNumber">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CallCenterId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="Description" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="Name" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Phone" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
```
